content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SAIL BSP Advisor/Consultant (Liaison & Administration) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SAIL BSP Advisor/Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 06-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Advisor/Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be ex-executives of SAIL from Grade E3 to E7, with a good service record and no ongoing disciplinary proceedings. They should also be physically and mentally fit.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Advisor/Consultant (Liaison & Administration) post is 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Advisor/Consultant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Advisor/Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a contractual position.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Steel Authority of India Bhilai Steel Plant (SAIL BSP).

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is Advisor-L&A/2026-27/878.
